title: Dublin Property: What You're Actually Paying Per Square Metre in 2026
excerpt: Forget the asking price — the real measure of Dublin property value is cost per square metre. Our analysis of 4,100+ live listings across 22 postcodes reveals a 2:1 gap between D4/D6 (€8,000+/sqm) and D10/D22 (under €4,000/sqm), and which areas give buyers the most space for their budget.
author: Market Research Team
